Barcelona and Real Madrid were at Anfield on Sunday to watch Erling Haaland when Manchester City faced Liverpool. Meanwhile, Chelsea are growing confident they will be able to sign AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott in January.

Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Trending rumors

Erling Haaland scored the opener in Man City's 3-0 win over Liverpool on Sunday. Michael Regan/Getty Images

- Barcelona and Real Madrid scouts were at Anfield to scout Manchester City striker Erling Haaland as he opened the scoring in a 3-0 win over Liverpool, according to TEAMtalk. Both of the Spanish giants continue to monitor the possibility of a future move following the club's guilty verdict for hundreds of financial charges. The two clubs weren't just there to watch City players, though: Barça have also been monitoring the situation of defender Ronald Araújo, who is on loan at Liverpool, while Madrid have been checking on Liverpool midfielders Alexis Mac Allister and Florian Wirtz.

- Chelsea are increasingly confident that they will sign AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott during the January transfer window, according to TEAMtalk. The belief is that the 23-year-old would find it difficult to turn down a move to Stamford Bridge and the Blues are willing to meet the Cherries' demands, with any deal likely to reach around £100 million. Bournemouth turned down all interest in Scott during the summer, but the England international's contract expires in 2028 and he has so far resisted any calls for an extension.

- Borussia Dortmund have been interested in U.S. youth international and Philadelphia Union striker Malik Jakupovic for some time, reports Sky Germany. In the summer, the Bundesliga club submitted an offer for the 17-year-old that was worth €2m-€3m but was ultimately rejected. Contact continues to exist but there is major competition for Jakupovic with Chelsea, RB Salzburg and Stuttgart all looking at him while Eintracht Frankfurt also have in the past.

- Chelsea will need at least £50 million to tempt Barcelona into letting midfielder Frenkie de Jong leave in the January transfer window, according to Football Insider. Chelsea are looking at the 29-year-old as they continue their efforts to replace Enzo Fernández after the Argentina international joined Manchester City in the summer. De Jong is out injured but the Dutch midfield is nearing a return to fitness, although that return could make a move more difficult for the Blues as Barça have been eagerly awaiting his return.

- Ruben Amorim wants AC Milan to sign Sassuolo midfielder Darryl Bakola, who has also received interest from Roma and Juventus, reports Calciomercato. Amorim was surprised by the 18-year-old's quality when the Rossoneri drew 1-1 against Sassuolo at Mapei Stadium, when Bakola was named man of the match. The young Frenchman is being considered by scouts across Europe, and having been signed for €10 million plus €2 million in add-ons last January, he could now command over €30 million.

Done deals

- Former Real Madrid right back Dani Carvajal has joined LaLiga side Getafe on a free transfer.

Other

- Arsenal are keeping an eye on Michael Olise's contract talks with Bayern Munich as they continue to look at wingers. (FootballTransfers)

- Arsenal are yet to make a decision about Max Dowman's future amid interest in a loan from Celtic and Rangers. (Football Insider)

- Several major clubs are interested in a January move for Palmeiras right back Agustin Giay, with Atletico Madrid, AC Milan and Napoli having previously made approaches. (Matteo Moretto)

- Brighton & Hove Albion see RB Salzburg midfielder Bartosz Mazurek as a leading option for January, but they face competition from Benfica and Porto. (TEAMtalk)

- Borussia Dortmund have the right to match any offer for Monaco striker Paris Brunner. (Patrick Berger)

- Napoli have started to show an interest in Union Berlin winger Livan Burcu, who is also attracting attention from other top European clubs. (Rudy Galetti)

- Borrusia Dortmund remain interested in Zaglebie Lubin attacking midfielder Marcel Rugela, but a summer move for the 19-year-old is more likely than one in January. (Patrick Berger)

- Lazio have their eyes on 18-year-old winger Filippo Toscano from Serie D side Reggina as they look to the future. (Nicolo Schira)

- Johan Bakayoko is a possible candidate to leave RB Leipzig in January despite only joining the Bundesliga club last year. (Philipp Hinze)

- AC Milan are working for a way to offload 23-year-old midfielder Warren Bondo in January. (Nicolo Schira)
